newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran starts operating S. Korean-built oil tanker.
newsitem.headline: Iran starts operating S. Korean-built oil tanker.

text.p: Iran on Thursday started operating a 300,000-tonne South Korean-built oil tanker, one of five new ships it is bying under a $490 million deal to replace its ageing fleet, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It said the very large crude carrier (VLCC) Iran Najm, recently delivered to the state-owned National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC), set out for Mediterranean ports after loading at the Kharg Island in the Gulf.
NITC in May took delivery of Iran Nour, the first of five tankers ordered from South Korea's Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd for a total cost of $490 million.
Iran is the world's third largest oil exporter. The five tankers would boost itss tanker capacity to 3.6 million tonnes from 2.1 million tonnes.
